policy: These are point-in-time read-only estimates, not guaranteed future pricing.
Do not extrapolate a subscription total until Joey chooses a plan and current allowances/credits are known.
Still exploration may use cheap/unlimited-compatible models when quality is sufficient, but an allowance choice is never made silently on Joey's behalf.
Motion starts only after the source still passes its quality gate.
If a premium motion test is not materially better on mobile than a still/CSS/sprite version, reject the motion and keep the cheaper implementation.
